contentText:
SteelSeries moved the system-level Xbox buttons to the bottom of the controller. | Image: Cameron Faulkner / The Verge

SteelSeries is a household name for many gamers, but not when it comes to controllers. Instead of easing into the conversation with reasonably-priced console and PC controllers to build trust, it's kicking down the door with the $259.99 Aeon Pro wireless controller for Xbox and PC, which starts shipping today.

What does one of the most expensive controllers out there do that others don't? A few things. The one you'll likely notice first is its tiny OLED screen that can guide you through swapping between Xbox, PC, or Bluetooth.
